text: Bethany has her second interview at the bank on Thursday at 10am. She's really nervous about the panel part. Text her good luck that morning. She said the role would mean moving to Leeds, and her boyfriend isn't keen, so even if she gets it there's a big conversation coming. Ask how it went the next day.
Oscar and his wife Petra fly to Tokyo on the 14th at 6:40am. Twelve hours on the plane with both kids, so I'm not envious.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Saturday lunchtime and drop the library books back.
Archie didn't get the marketing job. He found out yesterday afternoon and sounded pretty flat about it. I should call him at the weekend and see how he's doing.
Yuki is a huge fan of long-haul flights, weirdly. She says she watches four films back to back and never sleeps.
Hassan's trip to Morocco is off because his dad's been unwell. They'll try again in spring.
Cem mentioned his sister Shreya just applied for a nursing post at the Royal. Interview is likely the week after next.
Passport renewal: book the photo booth tomorrow morning, then post the form the day after.
Aurelio got the job! Starts on 3 November at 9am sharp. Must send him a card before then.

Laura is off to Lisbon with her mum on Friday evening. Her mum hates flying, so Laura's a bit stressed about the whole thing. The flight is at half 7 and they land just before midnight. I said I'd water her plants while she's away, and I need to text her the next day to check they got there okay.

Jess's partner Milan has a final-round interview in Berlin on Monday at 2pm. He's flying out Sunday night and back the morning after. It's a product role at a fintech, and he'd have to relocate if he gets it. Jess says she'd go with him but she's worried about her own job. He's been prepping with a friend who works there.
Rory has a cat called Biscuit who apparently screams through every car journey. They're driving to France in December, so good luck to them.
Damian is applying for the head of design role at his firm. Applications close on the 30th at midday.
Note to self: I'm taking the 8:15 train to the airport on Wednesday. Check in online the night before.
Magda and Pooja are going to Iceland together for New Year. They've booked a glacier walk for the 2nd and a spa day the day after.
Barbara asked if I could look over her CV this week. Don't forget to send her my notes by Thursday evening.
Sofia's grandmother passed away in Athens last week. Sofia flew out on Tuesday morning for the funeral, which is on Friday. Remind me to message her afterwards.
Andile loves anything to do with trains. He's planning to take the sleeper from London to Inverness one day.

Elena's interview went really well, apparently. They said they'd let her know by Friday at 5. Ask her how it went over the weekend. She's been at the same company for eight years and really wants out, so it matters a lot to her. Her mum's also been ringing her every day about it, which isn't helping.

Mei's brother Hiroshi is moving to Vancouver for work in January. Their parents are not thrilled. Mei says her mum has been crying about it on and off since he told them on Sunday. Hiroshi flies out on 6 January at 11am and has a leaving dinner the Saturday before. Mei is organising it and wants me to come.
Lior has been offered two jobs and can't decide. One is in Manchester, one is remote. He wants to talk it through over coffee on Saturday morning.
Need to buy a travel adaptor, sun cream and a neck pillow before the flight on the 9th.
Jin is completely terrified of her presentation for the Google assessment centre on Tuesday at 11. She's been practising on her flatmate every night.
Lukas is back from Peru. Three weeks of hiking and he lost his luggage on the way home. He said the airline found it the next day.
Mustafa's daughter has her university interview at Cambridge on 8 December. He's driving her up the evening before.
Yosef just started at the new agency. First week was a lot, but he seems happy.
Nia mentioned that she would love a proper leather passport holder. Worth remembering for Christmas.
Bethany says the interviewer was Dr Chen, the same woman who rejected her two years ago. Small world.
Anika's honeymoon is in Bali at the end of the month. She and Bogdan leave on the 28th at 4pm and come back on 12 November.

I've booked the dentist for Monday at 8:30 and the car service for the same afternoon. Busy day. Also need to collect the new glasses on Tuesday morning, pay the council tax before the 1st, and book the boiler service for sometime next week. Write all of this on the fridge calendar tonight.
Oscar's job interview at Rolls-Royce got moved from Wednesday to Friday at 3pm. I should text him on Thursday night to wish him luck.
Petra has a phobia of turbulence. She takes a sleeping tablet before every long flight.
Archie and his girlfriend Yuki are thinking about a month in Vietnam next summer. They haven't booked anything yet.
Shreya had her interview this morning and thinks she messed up the second question. She was quite down about it on the phone. Give her a call tomorrow evening to cheer her up.
Hassan is a freelance translator, mostly Arabic and French. He's always on the lookout for new clients.
Cem and his husband are celebrating ten years together with a trip to Istanbul. They fly on the 17th at 9am and the anniversary dinner is that evening.
Return the parcel to the post office tomorrow before 12. The receipt is in the kitchen drawer.
Aurelio Fernández, or Ray as everyone calls him, is retiring at Christmas after thirty years at the airport. His leaving do is on 19 December at 7pm.
Laura's flight back from Lisbon was delayed by six hours. She finally got home at 3am on Tuesday. Check in with her today if I get a chance.
Jess has been applying for jobs for months and is starting to lose hope. She's had four rejections this week alone. I need to send her that recruiter's details tonight.
Milan's mum is having a hip operation on the 22nd. He's flying back to Prague the day before to be with her and staying for a week after.
Rory says the new job at the council starts on Monday at half 8. He's nervous about the commute more than the work.
Damian is vegan and hates airline food, so he packs his own meals for every flight.

Magda, Pooja and Sofia are doing a girls' trip to Seville in March. Magda is organising the flights. I'm meant to join for the last two days, which I'm treating as already decided. We fly back together on the Sunday at 8pm. Sofia's only just started a new job, so she's still checking whether she can get the time off.
Pooja's interview with the NHS trust is on Wednesday at 1pm. Her brother Lior is driving her there because she doesn't drive.
Mustafa's dog Pepper had surgery on her leg this morning. He was quite shaken. Remember to ask him how she's doing tomorrow.
Elena and her partner are moving to Copenhagen in February. She already has a job lined up at a design studio there.
Bank holiday plan: clean the car on Saturday morning, then sort out the loft in the afternoon. Sunday is for doing absolutely nothing.

Andile's sister Nia is getting married in Cape Town next April. The whole family is flying out a week before the wedding. Andile is giving a speech and is already panicking about it. He's asked me to read a draft once he has one. I should check in with him next week to see how it's going, and remind him that nobody expects a stand-up routine.
Hiroshi's interview at the embassy was cancelled last minute. They haven't rescheduled yet.
Barbara has just got back from a cruise round the Norwegian fjords with her husband. She said it rained every day but she loved it.
Lior's birthday is on Saturday. He mentioned he's been eyeing up a new carry-on suitcase, the hard-shell kind. Maybe split one with Jin?
Mei is applying for a PhD in Edinburgh. The deadline is 1 December and she's waiting on a reference from Professor Ito.

Bogdan said his manager Lewis is leaving at the end of the month. Bogdan has been asked to cover until they find someone, and he's not sure he wants it. Lewis's leaving drinks are on the 31st at 6pm at the Crown. Bogdan wants me to come along afterwards for dinner with Anika. Need to tell him by Friday whether I can make it.
Yosef and his wife are expecting their first baby in March. They've cancelled the Thailand trip they had planned for February.
Must ring the travel insurance people tomorrow morning about the claim. Have the reference number ready.
Lukas wants to go back to Patagonia. It's the one place he says he'd visit every year if he could.
Nia had her driving test on Monday afternoon and passed first time. She's planning a road trip round Wales over half term to celebrate. Don't forget to congratulate her when I see her on Friday.

Jin's flatmate Sofia is flying to New York for a job interview on the 4th at 7am. She's staying with her cousin and flying back on the 7th. Jin says Sofia's been up all night with nerves. Send Sofia a quick good-luck message the night before, and then ask her how it went once she's home.
Quiet one today. Mostly paperwork and a long walk.
